card.name: Inside the word dyskinesia
card.fires_on: Partway through the word dyskinesia or dyskinetic (dys, k, kin), mostly in Parkinson's drug labels. Also fires on words describing involuntary movement like body swaying.

modes.label: Dyskinesia spelling
modes.description: The pieces dys, k or kin inside dyskinesia/dyskinetic in warnings and dose text.
modes.example: Pramipexole dihydrochloride extended-release tablets may cause or exacerbate preexisting dys<<k>>inesia.

modes.label: Movement description
modes.description: A word in a list of abnormal body movements.

card.writes: It pushes toward movement words like kinetic, swing and flight, and away from words starting with u.
card.plain: It lights up when the word dyskinesia (abnormal involuntary movements) is being spelled out.
